global_operation_recount.measured_at: head b70d1a04, PostgreSQL 16 at migration head 20260915_0003
corrections_to_the_previously_published_: The earlier published block headlined 5060 operations but its printed breakdown sums to 5053. The missing 7 are CreateUniqueConstraintOp, which the breakdown omitted. The headline was right; the itemisation was incomplete.

Only ONE delta is attributable to a single change and was measured immediately before and after it: DropColumnOp 377 -> 365, from NR-089 mixing TrustSoftDeleteMixin in. The movement in AddColumnOp (314 -> 293) and AlterColumnOp (73 -> 85) spans several commits — the NR-083 migrations 20260915_0001/_0002 and the NR-085 enum repair 20260915_0003 all landed between the two measurements — so it is NOT attributed to NR-089 and no per-commit cause is claimed for it.
Destructive total 1379 -> 1367 is exactly the 12 trust columns, and reconciles.
global_operation_recount.ratchet_health: all four declared destructive counts measured EXACT against DECLARED_DESTRUCTIVE_BUDGET — 538/454/365/10 — so the ledger carries no slack. A ratchet that only forbids growth would let a silent shrink leave the declared value overstated; this was checked rather than assumed.
